info.name: Pathway Analysis Service database exporter API
Exports a given pathway diagram to the specified image format (png, jpg, jpeg, svg, gif)

params.name: identifier
params.description: Event identifier (it can be a pathway with diagram, a subpathway or a reaction)

params.name: ext
params.description: File extension (defines the image format)

params.name: quality
params.description: Result image quality between [1 - 10]. It defines the quality of the final image (Default 5)

params.name: flg
params.description: Gene name, protein or chemical identifier or Reactome identifier used to flag elements in the diagram

params.name: flgInteractors
params.description: Defines whether to take into account interactors for the flagging

params.name: sel
params.description: Highlight element(s) selection in the diagram. CSV line.

params.name: title
params.description: Sets whether the name of the pathway is shown below

params.name: margin
params.description: Defines the image margin between [0 - 20] (Default 15)

params.name: ehld
params.description: Defines whether textbook-like illustration are taken into account

params.name: diagramProfile
params.description: Diagram Color Profile

params.name: token
params.description: The analysis token with the results to be overlaid on top of the given diagram

params.name: resource
params.description: The analysis resource for which the results will be overlaid on top of the given pathways overview

params.name: analysisProfile
params.description: Analysis  Color Profile

params.name: expColumn
params.description: Expression column. When the token is associated to an expression analysis, this parameter allows specifying the expression column for the overlay

params.name: view
params.description: Global parameter - Customise the view to be more concise and/or aggregate relationships

params.name: includeRef
params.description: Global parameter - If true, replace element ref to dbId by standard JSOG object {@ref}

items.docs:
This method accepts identifiers for Event class instances.
When a diagrammed pathway is provided, the diagram is exported to the specified format.
When a subpathway is provided, the diagram for the parent is exported and the events that are part of the subpathways are selected.
When a reaction is provided, the diagram containing the reaction is exported and the reaction is selected.

Find out more about this method

items.docs:
This method accepts identifiers for Event class instances.
The generated document contains the details for the given event and, optionally, its children (see level parameter). These details include:
- A diagram image
- Summation
- Literature references
- Edit history
- Other details: type, location, compartments, diseases

Documents can also be overlaid with pathway an
